A large part of the role involves daily collaboration with cross-functional teams across [Company name masked] to hypothesize, formulate, develop, deliver, and improve data science products that advance data-driven insights, decisions, simulation, actions, and automation.
cond_0078.responsibilities:
Develop and deploy data mining and advanced analytics to monitor, benchmark, and optimize business needs, identifying areas for improvement and deeper, root-cause analysis
Develop and deploy models, simulation models, and other advanced analytics solutions to enable data-driven decision-making to meet Supply Chain objectives
Apply business acumen to continuously develop new features to improve analytical models
Actively partner with cross-functional business stakeholders on assumptions, opportunities, and solutions — regularly connecting with teams to clarify requirements and walk them through findings
Collaborate to guide standards, best practices, solution innovation, future solution needs, and keep current with industry trends
Identify relationships and trends, perform statistical analysis, and implement machine learning algorithms for prediction, forecasting, and classification
Advance our analytics maturity and data-driven culture
cond_0078.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree
3+ Years of experience developing and applying operational research models, data mining applications, and advanced analytics
Experience using statistical computer languages (R, Python, SQL) to manipulate data and draw insights from large datasets
Knowledge of advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests and proper usage) and experience with applications
Strong problem-solving skills with an emphasis on product development
Strong written and verbal communication skills for staying in regular contact and coordinating across teams
Legally authorized to work in [Location masked] without employer sponsorship now or in the future
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks) and their real-world advantages/drawbacks
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Snowflake, and other cloud platforms
Willingness to learn and pick up new technologies and techniques
Ability to travel up to 20–30% to [Location masked]

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience

Willingness to travel up to 20–30% to [Location masked]
Must be legally authorized to work in [Location masked] without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future

Background in advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests and proper usage) and some experience with applications
Familiarity with Databricks, Snowflake and other cloud platforms
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally when coordinating across teams
Openness to learning new technologies and techniques
Problem solving skills with an emphasis on product development

A large part of the role involves staying in regular contact with cross-functional teams across [Company name masked] to hypothesize, formulate, develop, deliver, and improve data science products that advance data-driven insights, decisions, simulation, actions, and automation.
cond_0303.responsibilities:
Develop and deploy data mining and advanced analytics to monitor, benchmark, and optimize business needs, identifying areas for improvement and deeper, root-cause analysis
Develop and deploy models, simulation models, and other advanced analytics solutions to enable data-driven decision-making to meet Supply Chain objectives
Apply business acumen to continuously develop new features to improve analytical models
Actively partner with cross-functional business stakeholders on assumptions, opportunities, and solutions, regularly communicating progress and walking them through findings
Collaborate to guide standards, best practices, solution innovation, and future solution needs, and speak up to keep the team current with industry trends
Identify relationships and trends, perform statistical analysis, and implement machine learning algorithms for prediction, forecasting, and classification
Advance our analytics maturity and data-driven culture
cond_0303.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree
3+ Years of experience developing and applying operational research models, data mining applications, and advanced analytics
Strong problem solving skills with an emphasis on product development
Experience using statistical computer languages (R, Python, SQL) to manipulate data and draw insights from large datasets
Knowledge of a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks) and their real-world advantages/drawbacks
Knowledge of advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests and proper usage) and experience with applications
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Snowflake and other Cloud platforms
A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams, including the ability to clearly explain trade-offs and handle questions from stakeholders
We ask that you travel up to 20-30% to [Location masked]
Applicants for this role must be legally authorized to work in [Location masked] without requiring employer sponsorship either now or in the future

Daily responsibilities include partnering with cross-functional teams across [Company name masked] to hypothesize, formulate, develop, deliver, and improve data science products to help advance data-driven insights, decisions, simulation, actions, and automation. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of supply chain data and the analytical problems it involves.
cond_0427.responsibilities:
Develop and deploy data mining and advanced analytics to monitor, benchmark, and optimize business needs, identifying areas for improvement and deeper, root-cause analysis
Develop and deploy models, simulation models, and other advanced analytics solutions to enable data-driven decision-making to meet Supply Chain objectives
Apply business acumen to continuously develop new features to improve analytical models
Partner with cross-functional business stakeholders on assumptions, opportunities, and solutions
Collaborate to guide standards, best practices, solution innovation, future solution needs and keep current with industry trends
Identify relationships and trends, perform statistical analysis and implement machine learning algorithms for prediction, forecasting and classification
Advance our analytics maturity and data-driven culture
cond_0427.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree
3+ Years of experience developing and applying operational research models, data mining applications, and advanced analytics
Strong problem solving skills with an emphasis on product development
Experience using statistical computer languages (R, Python, SQL) to manipulate data and draw insights from large datasets
Knowledge of a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks) and their real-world advantages/drawbacks
Knowledge of advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests and proper usage) and experience with applications
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Snowflake and other Cloud platforms
A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams
We ask that you travel up to 20-30% to [Location masked]
At this time, we require applicants for this role to be legally authorized to work in [Location masked] without requiring employer sponsorship either now or in the future.
cond_0427.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.

Bachelor's Degree

Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams
Legally authorized to work in [Location masked] without requiring employer sponsorship either now or in the future

Knowledge of a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks) and their real-world advantages/drawbacks
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Snowflake and other Cloud platforms
A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
Ability to travel up to 20-30% to [Location masked]
